name: sprint-status-report
description: Reads the current sprint from any supported tracker (Azure DevOps, Jira), tallies work items by state (Done / In Progress / To Do), computes percent complete and remaining count, flags blocked and stale items, and emits a Marp markdown deck ready to export to PPTX/PDF. Each completed, in-progress, and up-next ticket carries a brief one-line detail of what it is. Read-only and safe to run anytime; no writes, no confirmation gate. Tracker-agnostic via issuekit. Bundles sprint-analyst and deck-composer skills.
